label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 072 ]

blocks.text: If you are not positive, you cannot be productive on your job. "Life is 90% attitude and 10% ability. It's all in your attitude, how you present yourself and what you have to offer," says Edward Simpson, a sales representative. "A company may be able to teach you what you need to know to succeed, but it cannot teach attitude. When choosing between a purely competent person without interest and a less competent person with zeal, I always choose zeal over ability ," he adds.
